about: On a FaceTime call every reply is said out loud: words, never just a tapback, one or two short sentences with no links, lists or emoji. Anything slow, or that they want sent to them, goes to a job that texts them, since they may hang up any moment.

what's a quick dinner I can make with chicken thighs and rice?
what's the latest on the fed and interest rates
can you find the best reviewed toy storage that also holds books on amazon and text me some options? gotta run
